name: pg_horizon
abstract: Diagnose PostgreSQL XID/MultiXact freeze horizons and attribute the backends, slots, and prepared transactions that hold them
description: pg_horizon reads the same exported horizon functions VACUUM uses, then attributes blockers from PGPROC, replication slots, and prepared transactions. It tells you whether freeze is stuck on a horizon holder or on vacuum lag, and it refuses wraparound workarounds such as VACUUM FULL or silently raising autovacuum_freeze_max_age.
